message: YARN_ENABLE_SCRIPTS=true is set in the env of job build in .github/workflows/ci.yml, reaches every Yarn (Berry) command there, and lets dependency install scripts run that depcurfew.json denies for Yarn (Berry)
fix: Remove YARN_ENABLE_SCRIPTS from that env in .github/workflows/ci.yml; to let a package run its install scripts, add it to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply

message: YARN_NPM_MINIMAL_AGE_GATE=60 is set in the env of job build in .github/workflows/ci.yml, reaches every Yarn (Berry) command there, and sets the release-age delay of Yarn (Berry) to 1 hour, shorter than the 3d of depcurfew.json
fix: Remove YARN_NPM_MINIMAL_AGE_GATE from that env in .github/workflows/ci.yml; for a package that cannot wait, add it to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply

message: job build in .github/workflows/ci.yml (line 9) runs Yarn (Berry) with --no-time-gate, which weakens the release-age delay of Yarn (Berry) (3d in depcurfew.json)
fix: Remove --no-time-gate from that command in .github/workflows/ci.yml; for a package that cannot wait, add it to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply
